decks.title: Wisdom & Guidance
decks.description: A collection of Bible passages about wisdom and guidance, for personal study and memorization. World English Bible.

cards.verseText: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.
I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.
For the LORD gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding. He lays up sound wisdom for the upright. He is a shield to those who walk in integrity,
Show me your ways, LORD. Teach me your paths. Guide me in your truth, and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation. I wait for you all day long.
Listen to counsel and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end. There are many plans in a man’s heart, but the LORD’s counsel will prevail.

Turn your ear, and listen to the words of the wise. Apply your heart to my teaching. For it is a pleasant thing if you keep them within you, if all of them are ready on your lips. I teach you today, even you, so that your trust may be in the LORD.
Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.
Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.
Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls, but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.
One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.
He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does the LORD require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?
A simple man believes everything, but the prudent man carefully considers his ways.
